source_caption:
🎬 Holiday in the Wild (2019)

Holiday in the Wild follows Kate Conrad, a devoted mother whose life takes an unexpected turn when her husband announces that he wants to end their marriage shortly before their planned second honeymoon. Determined not to let heartbreak ruin her plans, Kate travels alone to Africa, where she meets Derek Holliston, a charming pilot who introduces her to the extraordinary world of wildlife conservation. After helping rescue an orphaned baby elephant, Kate decides to extend her stay at an elephant sanctuary in Zambia, rediscovering her passion for veterinary medicine and finding a renewed sense of purpose. As Christmas approaches, she develops a meaningful connection with Derek and begins questioning whether the life she left behind is truly the one she wants. Starring Kristin Davis and Rob Lowe, the film delivers beautiful scenery, heartwarming romance, and inspiring storytelling about second chances, self-discovery, animal conservation, love, and finding happiness in unexpected places.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Comedy • Drama • Holiday

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 25m • TV-PG

🎥 Director: Ernie Barbarash

✍️ Writers: Neal H. Dobrofsky & Tippi Dobrofsky

📍 Setting: New York City and Zambia, Africa.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix.

source_details.synopsis: Holiday in the Wild is a 2019 American Christmas romantic comedy film directed by Ernie Barbarash from a screenplay by Neal Dobrofsky and Tippi Dobrofsky. It stars Rob Lowe and Kristin Davis. The film was released on November 1, 2019, by Netflix.
